modules.note: Monolithic server bootstrap. It owns authenticated telemetry routes, HTTPS creation, production WsRouter construction, and the /ws upgrade dispatcher; startServer() is private and executes at module load, so an in-process production-upgrade test cannot import a factory directly. Evidence: server/src/index.ts:797-815, server/src/index.ts:888, server/src/index.ts:1464-1495, server/src/index.ts:1597.

Central WebSocket, replay, repair, and per-client send-policy module. WsRouterOptions declares realtime, but the constructor does not consume it; handleUpgrade authenticates and emits only the auth payload, while setupConnectionHandler accepts only ws/request. Evidence: server/src/ws/WsRouter.ts:86-91, server/src/ws/WsRouter.ts:165-224, server/src/ws/WsRouter.ts:223-258.

Browser socket authority. Production currently constructs one unified URL and one WebSocket; the remount grace buffer intentionally skips screen-repair frames. Evidence: frontend/src/contexts/WebSocketContext.tsx:113-119, frontend/src/contexts/WebSocketContext.tsx:141-155, frontend/src/contexts/WebSocketContext.tsx:340-388.

Focused retained-state primitive. Snapshot serialization is explicitly viewport-only and returns empty data with truncated=true above maxSnapshotBytes; repair serialization enumerates the active viewport and cursor. Evidence: server/src/utils/headlessTerminal.ts:95-145, server/src/utils/headlessTerminal.ts:156-203.

Largest stateful module in scope. It owns viewport-only snapshot cache/fallback, headless writes, replay limit, event-loop/CPU sampling, and cumulative headless-write time. Evidence: server/src/services/SessionManager.ts:100-126, server/src/services/SessionManager.ts:2482-2604, server/src/services/SessionManager.ts:3008-3065, server/src/services/SessionManager.ts:3486-3494.

xterm runtime and local retained-state owner. It saves viewport-only local snapshots, restores only exact geometry, replaces snapshots, and applies viewport repair under readiness checks. Evidence: frontend/src/components/Terminal/TerminalView.tsx:1093-1166, frontend/src/components/Terminal/TerminalView.tsx:1283-1397, frontend/src/components/Terminal/TerminalView.tsx:1399-1499.

Frontend recovery orchestrator. Snapshot delivery has a pending ref and retry handoff across terminal absence, while screen repair is applied/ACKed immediately and has no equivalent pending handoff. Evidence: frontend/src/components/Terminal/TerminalContainer.tsx:1323-1507, frontend/src/components/Terminal/TerminalContainer.tsx:1509-1584.

Pure injected scheduling seam. write, schedule, shouldYield, and now can be replaced for NO_RENDER and deterministic timing without UI changes. Large custom sequential test runner with a name filter and reusable fake PTY, headless-session, and fake-WebSocket harnesses. It has no benchmark-mode, manifest, raw-sample, or production HTTPS-upgrade runner. Evidence: server/src/test-runner.ts:614-641, server/src/test-runner.ts:2311-2384, server/src/test-runner.ts:13607-13682, server/src/test-runner.ts:14514-14595.
